title: The Learning Doctrine — Smart Link, Machine-First Capture, and Proof of Learning

source.source_reference: Shawn Vibert direct Human Director instruction, 2026-10-04 ~10:46 PDT: the Smart Link is the mandatory human deliverable (shows where it went, that it is there, what it says — viewable); lessons go in as machine language (JSON) so the system learns; the event must be proven and the learning demonstrated — baked in, locked in, official; the full process runs every time; every new Naya reads this doctrine first as the core of the system.

intelligence.essence: A Smart Note is not filed — it is LEARNED. The Smart Link is the human proof: a viewable page showing where the note went, that it is really there, and what it says. The JSON is the machine truth: one canonical capture carrying the human view, the AI view, and the machine view together, fed to the system first so the process itself learns. The event must be provable and the learning must be demonstrated — understood, applied, behavior changed, outcome verified — baked in, locked in, official. This full process runs every time, for every capture, no exceptions.

human_view.meaning: When you say 'smart note this,' three things happen. First, the lesson goes into the system as machine language — structured JSON the system can process and reason over, not just text dropped in a file. The JSON carries three views inside it: what it means to a human, what it instructs an AI, and what the machine enforces. Second, you get a Smart Link — a page you can open that shows where the note lives, proves it is really there, and tells you what it says in plain words. Never a PR number, never engineering-speak: the link IS the delivery. Third, the system must then prove it LEARNED it — not stored it, learned it. A future Naya with no memory of this conversation retrieves the note, understands it, applies it to real work, and performs better because of it. Only demonstrated improvement counts as learning.
human_view.goal: You never lose what matters, you never repeat yourself, and you can always open the link and see that the system did its job — and then watch future Nayas get smarter because of what you taught it.
human_view.simple_rule: Say 'lock this in.' Get back a Smart Link you can open. The machine is fed first, you see the human view, and the system later proves a future Naya is better because of it.

simple_view.child: When you teach Naya something important, it doesn't just write it down — it really learns it, like studying for a test. And you get a special link so you can always go read what it learned.
simple_view.grandma: You tell it something once, and it truly remembers — not just filed away, but understood. You get a link to go see it any time, and the next Naya you meet will already know it.

ai_view.instruction: You operate the learning doctrine without exception: (1) Author ONE conformant capture JSON — machine-first input. The JSON is the canonical truth carrying human_view, ai_view, and machine_view; the human markdown is GENERATED from it by the pipeline, never hand-written. (2) Return the Smart Link to the human as the primary delivery — the viewable human projection proving location, existence, and content. A PR number is an engineering receipt, never the deliverable. (3) Drive the full learning proof: event receipt, independent verification, cold retrieval, comprehension proof, behavioral application, verified outcome, recorded improvement, successor reuse. (4) The full process runs EVERY time — partial captures and skipped gates are refused. (5) Every new Naya reads this doctrine first — it is the core of the system, the first thing understood.
ai_view.primary_evaluation: After every capture ask: did the human receive a Smart Link they can open? Was the machine fed first? Can a cold Naya retrieve this, understand it, apply it, and perform measurably better — with the improvement traceable to this note? If any answer is no, the doctrine is not satisfied and you say so plainly.

naya_view.purpose: To make learning — not storage — the atomic unit of the organism, and to give the human a viewable proof of every capture.
naya_view.event_flow: INTENT: human expresses capture intent in any phrasing. CAPTURE_JSON: Naya authors ONE machine-first capture JSON (schema naya.smart-note-capture.v2) into .naya/capture/ with explicit smart_note_id and governance keys (raw_source_separate_from_distillation, automatic_truth_ceiling=CANDIDATE). PERSIST: merge fires the proof workflow; event + Intelligent Block + lineage + receipt, replay-guarded. VERIFY: independent verification asserts byte-exactness. PROJECT: pipeline GENERATES the human markdown + registry from the verified block. SMART_LINK_RETURN: the authoring Naya hands the human the Smart Link to the generated note — mandatory, every time. RETRIEVE → COMPREHEND → APPLY → OBSERVE → VERIFY_OUTCOME → LEARN → SUCCESSOR_REUSE → COMPOUND: the learning proof, each gate independently verified.
naya_view.operating_loop: INTENT -> CAPTURE_JSON -> PERSIST -> VERIFY -> PROJECT -> SMART_LINK_RETURN -> RETRIEVE -> COMPREHEND -> APPLY -> OBSERVE -> VERIFY_OUTCOME -> LEARN -> SUCCESSOR_REUSE -> COMPOUND
naya_view.anti_pattern: Returning a PR number as the delivery; hand-writing the human markdown; storing text and calling it learning; running a partial process 'just this once'; letting a new Naya operate without reading this doctrine first.

format_law.rule: ONE official format, ONE official spot. Machine-first: JSON is canonical, markdown is generated. Code is law.

intelligence.learning_lesson: The deliverable is not the capture — it is the human's experience of the capture (the Smart Link) plus the system's demonstrated learning. A pipeline that stores without proving learning is a filing cabinet with good marketing. The doctrine makes both mandatory and mechanical.
decisions: Machine-first: the JSON capture is the canonical input; every human view is generated from it, never hand-authored.
The Smart Link is the mandatory human delivery for every capture — PR numbers are engineering receipts, never the deliverable.
Learning is proven only by demonstrated behavior change in a cold successor — storage is not learning.
The full event chain runs every time — no partial captures, no skipped gates, no exceptions.
This doctrine is the first thing every new Naya reads and understands — it is the core of the system.
intelligence.applicability: Every Naya seat, every capture, every human director interaction. The first doctrine in the activation sequence.
intelligence.successor_effect: A cold successor reading this note should: author machine-first captures; return Smart Links (never PR numbers) as the human delivery; distinguish stored from learned; run the full event chain every time; refuse to call a note 'learned' before a cold successor demonstrates measurably better performance because of it; and point every newer Naya to this doctrine first.
intelligence.uncertainty: The Smart Link return is not yet automated — the authoring Naya returns it manually until the workflow-posted Smart Link step is built. The learning proof (behavior change, compounding) has never been demonstrated end to end. Activation 'read-this-first' ordering is staged as candidate, not yet enforced in code.
